description.value: Baiyulan Shanghai Cuisine is a sit-down Shanghainese restaurant in a Richmond strip mall, specializing in authentic dishes like Jelly Pork, Ham & Taro Soup, and Crispy Ginger Beef alongside a broad menu of specialty noodles, dim sum, and cold appetizers. The restaurant has built a loyal local following with 84 online reviews and caters to vegetarian diners. Cyclists can order online for pickup or delivery as well as dine in.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Shanghainese restaurant at #129-4940 Number 3 Rd, Richmond, matching the OSM address and unit. Takeout is confirmed by both the OSM tag (takeaway=yes) and the website ('Order online for Delivery or Pick-Up!'). The menu legend explicitly marks vegetarian and vegan items, and customer reviews corroborate vegetarian options; however, no evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears in either OSM tags or website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Baiyulan Shanghai Cuisine' but the website consistently uses 'Baiyulan Shanghai Restaurant'
OSM alt_name 'Chen's Shanghai Kitchen' differs substantially from both the OSM primary name and website name — may indicate a former business at this location or a data entry error
No phone number present in OSM; 604-304-8288 sourced from website only
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is clearly active and offers food relevant to touring cyclists, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking or visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence; on-site verification is needed before listing.
